item.title: Film about Riverhead Medal of Honor recipient Garfield Langhorn Jr. premieres at the Suffolk
item.description: A film about Riverhead Medal of Honor recipient Garfield M. Langhorn Jr. debuted Wednesday at the Suffolk theater.

item.title: DA: Former pizzeria employee charged with arson in Nov. 18 fire at Pazzo in Wading River
item.description: A former employee at Pazzo Ristorante and Wood Fired Pizzeria in Wading River is facing arson and other felonies in connection with the Nov. 18 fire at the pizzeria, the Suffolk D.A. announced Wednesday afternoon.

item.title: Riverhead Senior Center open as warming center Friday due to extreme cold
item.description: The Riverhead Senior Center at 60 Shade Tree Lane will be open until 4 p.m. Friday, Jan. 30, as a warming center amid extreme cold and subzero wind chills, town officials said.

item.title: Cold weather advisory in effect from midnight to 10 a.m. Saturday, for wind chill values of -5 to -10
item.description: A cold weather advisory is in effect from midnight until 10 a.m. Saturday, for wind chill values as low as -5º to -10º, the National Weather Service said.

item.title: Rothwell likely to get GOP nod for supervisor, as Dems await word from Halpin on re-election bid
item.description: Council Member Ken Rothwell, who was re-elected in November, was the only person to screen with the GOP for the supervisor race last week.

item.title: Lynne Marie Edwards, 60
item.description: Lynne Marie Edwards of New Bern, North Carolina, died Jan. 28, 2026, in New Bern, North Carolina. She was 60 years old.

item.title: Portions of Main Street to be closed to traffic Sunday morning for snow removal
item.description: Portions of Main Street in Riverhead will be closed Sunday morning for snow removal, Riverhead Highway Superintendent Mike Zaleski said.

item.title: Saks Off Fifth in Riverhead will close Monday, as parent company shutters most off-price stores
item.description: The financially troubled parent company, Saks Global, which filed for bankruptcy Jan. 14, announced Thursday it is closing all but 12 of its Off Fifth stores.

item.title: Riverhead police officers honored for saving life of a motorist after cardiac arrest behind the wheel
item.description: Police officers from across the East End were honored at the Southampton Kiwanis 54th Police Officer of the Year banquet in Riverhead Friday night. Photo gallery.

item.title: Locals turn out for vigil in memory of Alex Pretti and ‘ICE Out’ protest in Riverhead
item.description: Despite frigid temperatures, locals turned out for a Friday night vigil and Saturday morning protest in Riverhead. Photos.
